ProgramUnit.Name: DATE_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
package date_lov is
 last_lov_date number(2);
 current_lov_date date;

 lov_title varchar2(80);
 lov_auto_confirm boolean;

 weekend_day1 number;
 weekend_day2 number;
 Shifted_DOW number := 0;
 
 procedure display_cal(display_date in out date);
 procedure set_day_labels; 
 procedure date_click;
 procedure get_date (display_date in out date,
 v_x_pos in number := 0,
 v_y_pos in number := 0,
 v_title in varchar2 := 'Date List of Values',
 v_ok in varchar2 := 'OK',
 v_ToDay in varchar2 := 'ToDay', 
 v_cancel in varchar2 := 'Cancel',
 v_autoconfirm in boolean := FALSE );
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DATE_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
package body date_lov is
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 /*procedure set_day_labels*/
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 procedure set_day_labels
 is
 Langu varchar2(200); 
 RET NUMBER;
 begin

 Langu := Get_Application_Property(USER_NLS_LANGUAGE);
 if Langu = 'AMERICAN' then
 Shifted_DOW := 1;
 copy('Sat',
 'date_control_block.day_label1');
 copy('Sun',
 'date_control_block.day_label2');
 copy('Mon',
 'date_control_block.day_label3');
 copy('Tue',
 'date_control_block.day_label4');
 copy('Wed',
 'date_control_block.day_label5');
 copy('Thu',
 'date_control_block.day_label6');
 copy('Fri',
 'date_control_block.day_label7');
 
 else
 Shifted_DOW := 0;
 copy('سبت',
 'date_control_block.day_label1');
 copy('أحد',
 'date_control_block.day_label2');
 copy('إثنين',
 'date_control_block.day_label3');
 copy('ثلاثاء',
 'date_control_block.day_label4');
 copy('أربعاء',
 'date_control_block.day_label5');
 copy('خميس',
 'date_control_block.day_label6');
 copy('جمعة',
 'date_control_block.day_label7');
 end if;

 weekend_day1 := 6 - Shifted_DOW;
 weekend_day2 := 7 - Shifted_DOW;


 end set_day_labels;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 /*procedure display_cal*/
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

 procedure display_cal(display_date in out date)
 is
 first_date date;
 first_dow number;
 last_dom number;
 loop_begin number;
 loop_end number;
 current_date number;
 day_label number := 1;
 
 Temp_Greg_Date date;
 
 RET NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 -- Start of HEJ Date Display
 if :PARAMETER.Cal_Type = 'H' then

-- HijDate.TO_HIJRI(display_date, current_lov_date);
 current_lov_date := display_date;
 --display_date := current_lov_date;
 
 current_date := to_number(to_char(display_date,'MI'));
 first_date := to_date('01-'||to_char(display_date,'MM-YYYY'),'MI-MM-YYYY');
 HijDate.To_Greg(first_date, Temp_Greg_Date); 
 first_dow := to_number(to_char(Temp_Greg_Date,'d')) + Shifted_DOW;
 if first_dow = 8 then
 first_dow := 1;
 end if;

 last_dom := HijDate.last_hij_day(display_date);
 copy(to_char(display_date,'MM - YYYY'),
 'date_control_block.display_mon_year');

 loop_end := first_dow - 1;

 for i in 1..loop_end loop
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed, property_false);
 end loop;

 loop_end := last_dom + first_dow - 1;

 for i in first_dow..loop_end loop
 if get_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed) = 'FALSE' then
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed, property_true);
 end if;
 copy(to_char(day_label), 'date_button'||to_char(i));
 if day_label = current_date then
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), visual_attribute, 'date_selected_va');
 last_lov_date := i;
 else
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), visual_attribute, 'date_normal_va');
 end if;
 day_label := day_label + 1;
 end loop;

 if last_dom + first_dow <= 37 then
 loop_begin := last_dom + first_dow;
 loop_end := 37;
 for i in loop_begin..loop_end loop
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed, property_false);
 end loop;
 end if;


 -- Start of Greg Date Display
 elsif :PARAMETER.Cal_Type = 'G' then
 current_lov_date := display_date;
 current_date := to_number(to_char(display_date,'dd'));
 first_date := to_date('01-'||to_char(display_date,'mm-yyyy'),'dd-mm-yyyy');
 first_dow := to_number(to_char(first_date,'d')) + Shifted_DOW;
 if first_dow = 8 then
 first_dow := 1;
 end if;

 last_dom := to_number(to_char(last_day(display_date),'dd'));
 copy(to_char(display_date,'MM - YYYY'),
 'date_control_block.display_mon_year');

 loop_end := first_dow - 1;

 for i in 1..loop_end loop
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed, property_false);
 end loop;

 loop_end := last_dom + first_dow - 1;

 for i in first_dow..loop_end loop
 if get_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed) = 'FALSE' then
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed, property_true);
 end if;
 copy(to_char(day_label), 'date_button'||to_char(i));
 if day_label = current_date then
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), visual_attribute, 'date_selected_va');
 last_lov_date := i;
 else
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), visual_attribute, 'date_normal_va');
 end if;
 day_label := day_label + 1;
 end loop;

 if last_dom + first_dow <= 37 then
 loop_begin := last_dom + first_dow;
 loop_end := 37;
 for i in loop_begin..loop_end loop
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(i), displayed, property_false);
 end loop;
 end if;
 end if;
 go_item('date_control_block.OK_BUTTON');
 end display_cal;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 /*procedure get_date */
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

 procedure get_date (display_date in out date,
 v_x_pos in number := 0,
 v_y_pos in number := 0,
 v_title in varchar2 := 'Date List of Values',
 v_ok in varchar2 := 'OK',
 v_ToDay in varchar2 := 'ToDay', 
 v_cancel in varchar2 := 'Cancel',
 v_autoconfirm in boolean := FALSE )
 is
 date_window window;
 Temp_Hij_Date date;
 begin
 date_window := find_window('date_lov_window');

 -- set date lov window position
 set_window_property(date_window, position, v_x_pos, v_y_pos);

 -- set date lov window title
 set_window_property(date_window, title, v_title);

 -- set OK button label
 set_item_property('date_control_block.ok_button',label,v_ok);

 -- set OK button label
 set_item_property('date_control_block.ToDay',label,v_ToDay);

 -- set Cancel button label
 set_item_property('date_control_block.cancel_button',label,v_cancel);

 -- set date lov auto confirm flag
 lov_auto_confirm := v_autoconfirm;

 set_day_labels;
 if :PARAMETER.CAL_TYPE = 'G' then
 display_cal(display_date);
 elsif :PARAMETER.CAL_TYPE = 'H' then
 HijDate.To_Hijri(display_date, Temp_Hij_Date);
 display_cal(Temp_Hij_Date);
 end if;
 
 go_item('date_control_block.OK_BUTTON');
 end get_date;

 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 /*procedure date_click */
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

 procedure date_click
 is
 begin
 --Click On Greg Date
 if :PARAMETER.Cal_Type = 'G' then
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(date_lov.last_lov_date),
 visual_attribute, 'date_normal_va');

 set_item_property(name_in('system.trigger_item'),
 visual_attribute, 'date_selected_va');
 date_lov.last_lov_date := substr(name_in('system.trigger_item'),
 instr(name_in('system.trigger_item'),'.')+12);

 date_lov.current_lov_date := to_date(name_in(name_in('system.trigger_item')) || '-' ||
 to_char(date_lov.current_lov_date,'MM-YYYY'),'DD-MM-YYYY');

 if date_lov.lov_auto_confirm = TRUE then
 DATE_CHOOSEN;
 end if;

 --Click On Hijri Date
 elsif :PARAMETER.Cal_Type = 'H' then
 set_item_property('date_button'||to_char(date_lov.last_lov_date),
 visual_attribute, 'date_normal_va');

 set_item_property(name_in('system.trigger_item'),
 visual_attribute, 'date_selected_va');
 date_lov.last_lov_date := substr(name_in('system.trigger_item'),
 instr(name_in('system.trigger_item'),'.')+12);

 date_lov.current_lov_date := to_date(name_in(name_in('system.trigger_item')) || '-' ||
 to_char(date_lov.current_lov_date,'MM-YYYY'),'MI-MM-YYYY');
 if date_lov.lov_auto_confirm = TRUE then
 DATE_CHOOSEN;
 end if;
 end if;
 go_item('date_control_block.OK_BUTTON'); 
 end date_click;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 AUTO_SELECTION_BOOL BOOLEAN;
 V_SYS_DATE DATE;
BEGIN

 AUTO_SELECTION_BOOL := TRUE;
 ELSE
 AUTO_SELECTION_BOOL := FALSE;
 END IF;

 SELECT SYSDATE INTO V_SYS_DATE FROM DUAL;

 date_lov.get_date(:PARAMETER.START_DATE, -- initial date
 :PARAMETER.WIN_X_POS, -- window x position
 :PARAMETER.WIN_Y_POS, -- window y position
 :PARAMETER.WINDOW_TITLE, -- window title
 :PARAMETER.OK_LABLE, -- ok button label
 :PARAMETER.TODAY_LABLE, -- ToDay button label 
 :PARAMETER.CANCEL_LABLE, -- cancel button label
 AUTO_SELECTION_BOOL ); -- autoconfirm selection
END;
